Switch model allows shoppers to select a model that closely represents their body type, addressing the limitations of traditional product pages that typically display garments on a single model. This feature enables shoppers to view products from multiple angles — front and back — on their chosen model, delivering a realistic visualization of how a garment drapes and fits.
Multi-sizing, now live in testing on a limited selection of product pages, shows how a garment looks on a selected model in three different sizes: the recommended size, one size up and one size down.
Both features aim to enhance product pages, creating a more personalized and interactive experience that builds customer confidence and loyalty.

"Integrating these tools underscores our dedication to inclusivity," Blair Silverman, VP of e-commerce at Eileen Fisher, said in the release.
